CORPUS-02.title: Source volume narrowed into bounded analytical layers
CORPUS-02.design: four compact panels with exact counts and explicit units

side_visibility_chart.title: Safety records are more visible among records whose side could be classified

panel_A.label: show denominator and exact analytical unit next to each bar

panel_B.design: paired safety/non-safety bars among side-classified records only
panel_B.denominator: safety plus non-safety within each layer
panel_B.annotation: Bounded local comparisons are two-sided comparison units and remain a note, not a fifth side-classification bar

side_visibility_chart.required_interpretation: Safety-side records appear more often than non-safety records in the retained successfully classified evidence.
side_visibility_chart.required_boundary: The imbalance may reflect institutional differences, document formality, label clarity, source discovery, or unresolved classifications. It is not a national prevalence, wage-growth, or causal estimate.
forbidden: claim that non-safety mechanisms are absent
